A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same SGMD research work, with readable text, equations, figures, tables and Appendices A–E. The expanded bibliography shifts the unchanged appendices from pages 11–14 to pages 12–15.

before.justification: v1 reports original video-distillation experiments, ablations, human evaluation and VideoAlign results in Tables 1–4, plus the mixture-fitting experiment in Figure 1 and Appendix D.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experimental results, including the video-generation comparisons, human evaluation, ablations and mixture-fitting experiment.

M1.justification: The teacher stop-gradient Fisher objective, NR/RC potentials, two-step update, Algorithm 1 and Appendix B pseudocode are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same approximately 200K training prompts, text-to-video evaluations, qualitative scenarios and Appendix D mixture-fitting problem. No dataset, task or domain coverage is added or removed.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains DMD2, TSG-Fisher, TSG-SIM and the Wan2.1 teacher reference. Human and VideoAlign evaluations still compare SGMD with DMD2. Newly cited works are not evaluated as baselines.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 retains the same metrics, 300-iteration evaluation checkpoints, four sampling steps, 480×832 resolution and 81-frame videos. Ablation settings and Appendix D's numerical optimization protocol also remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The objective-component comparisons, lambda sensitivity sweep, qualitative video examples and mixture-fitting analysis are identical. No robustness test, ablation or supplementary analysis is added.

E5.justification: Both versions retain point estimates and preference percentages without adding repeated-run counts, seed information, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests.

E6.justification: All reported results match. For example, Table 1 retains SGMD's FVD of 100.3 and OptFlow of 9.29; Table 3 retains 65% overall preference and 71% motion-quality preference. Figures, ablation values and Appendix C's timing estimates are unchanged.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, Proposition 3.1, gradient derivations and Appendix A propositions and proofs are unchanged. Appendix D retains the same distributions and divergence definitions.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list and conclusion retain the same claims about the fake-score perspective, dual potentials, approximately threefold training speedup and improved motion with comparable visual quality and text alignment.

C2.justification: The explanations of tracking lag, unreliable teacher gradients, the dynamics-quality tradeoff and failures with excessive lambda are unchanged. No substantive limitation or applicability qualification is added.

D1.justification: The abstract's code link changes from the LightX2V repository root to its lightx2v_train directory, providing more specific access instructions. Implementation settings, hardware information and appendix pseudocode remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 1 adds nine citations with corresponding bibliography entries: Gong 2019 and 2025a/b, Li 2018 and 2021, Deng 2018, Yang 2019 and 2021, and FlagOS Team 2025. These expand introductory citation lists; Section 5's positioning against DMD, SIM and SiD remains unchanged.

P1.justification: Textual edits are limited to introductory citation lists, the abstract's code pointer and version/date text. The substantive prose, terminology, explanations and section ordering remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The abstract, introduction and bibliography reflow, with references extending onto another page and the appendices moving one page later. Figures 1–3, Tables 1–5 and Algorithm 1 retain their content and design.

improvement.justification: The more specific code pointer modestly improves navigation. However, v2 adds feature-caching citations whose bibliography titles concern cross-modal hashing, spectral clustering and rotated-object detection, without explaining their connection to caching. This weakens the precision of the background attribution; the scientific results and appendices remain unchanged.
